chars.KAIS: KAIS: a very tall skinny 21-year-old Moroccan man with shoulder-length curly black hair, a mustard-yellow knitted beanie, an oversized olive-green hoodie, ripped light-blue jeans, brown hiking boots, a small tattoo on his forearm
chars.JESS: JESS: a young American woman with a long blonde braid, a red bandana headband, a loose white linen shirt, beige hiking shorts, round sunglasses pushed on her head, a big blue backpack
chars.RIVAL: RIVAL: a muscular young Moroccan man with a short fade haircut, a black sleeveless tank top, a thick gold chain, a white baseball cap worn backwards, grey jogger pants
chars.AUNTIE: AUNTIE: an elderly rural Moroccan woman wearing a red-and-white striped mendil cloth wrapped over a brown djellaba and a wide straw hat with black pompoms

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Early morning at a campsite in the green Rif mountains near Chefchaouen. Colourful tents, a small gas stove with a silver Moroccan teapot. KAIS pours mint tea into a small glass and hands it to JESS, who smiles sleepily outside her tent. Soft golden sunrise light, peaceful mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A small mountain village with blue-and-white houses and stone walls. AUNTIE stands at her doorway holding a clay jar of butter and a round loaf of bread; KAIS and JESS buy from her, JESS looks delighted and amazed. Warm morning light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KAIS walks alone along a long dusty mountain path carrying several empty plastic water bottles toward a distant stone water spring, sweating, the camp far behind him in the valley. Wide shot, long walk, hot sun.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: KAIS comes back to the campsite carrying full water bottles and stops, surprised: in the background JESS is sitting on a rock laughing with RIVAL who sits very close to her. KAIS in the foreground with a confused frown.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the campsite RIVAL hugs JESS tightly with a cocky smile, JESS hugs him back politely and looks a bit awkward. Tents and mountains behind them.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of RIVAL sitting by the tents, smirking smugly with a sly look in his eyes, flexing his arm, a charming player attitude. Mountain campsite behind.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KAIS stands frozen next to his tent, holding a water bottle, jaw tight, staring with jealous disbelief at something off-frame. Evening light starting, dramatic shadows.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: KAIS sits alone in front of his tent at dusk with his hands on his head, very confused and worried, looking toward the other tents where two silhouettes sit together by a campfire. Moody blue twilight, suspense.
